milestones.title: Month 1 — scope and reproducibility
milestones.description: 40h work + 10h reserve; freeze rights, contracts, holdouts, and environment.

milestones.title: Month 4 — baseline evidence
milestones.description: 160h work + 40h reserve; runnable data and baseline pipeline with leakage controls.

milestones.title: Month 7 — first functional public release
milestones.description: 160h work + 40h reserve; cumulative 360h work + 90h reserve; usable replay, evaluation, exports and install instructions.

milestones.title: Month 10 — robustness and deployment
milestones.description: 160h work + 40h reserve; hardening, integration, workflow validation and operational packaging.

milestones.title: By month 12 — maintained handoff
milestones.description: 120h work + 30h reserve; security, release, maintenance rehearsal and final scope decision; 800h total.

issues.title: Freeze scouting decision and exclusions
issues.body: Output: docs/scope.md and docs/evidence-tiers.md. Steps: define corn-region scouting jobs, no-diagnosis wording and public-data technical finish. Acceptance: no deliverable depends on a farm partner, field visit or treatment recommendation. Test: walk high-rank, insufficient-data and unavailable-crop-identity scenarios. Dependencies: none; use the approved proposal and implementation protocol. Record commands, pinned inputs, observed results and remaining limitations in the output evidence. Keep all data provenance attached and do not introduce manual annotation. Stop at the stated deliverable; any scope or interface change requires the protocol's design review.

issues.title: Select public inputs and rights
issues.body: Output: data/licenses/manifest.json and data/study-area.json. Steps: record Sentinel and NASS terms; choose bounded study areas and completed seasons; exclude restricted datasets. Acceptance: all inputs have provenance and no private boundary or manual label dependency. Test: specify unavailable-source fallback and rejection of restricted dataset entries. Dependencies: CS-001. Record commands, pinned inputs, observed results and remaining limitations in the output evidence. Keep all data provenance attached and do not introduce manual annotation. Stop at the stated deliverable; any scope or interface change requires the protocol's design review.

issues.title: Freeze temporal and geographic contracts
issues.body: Output: schemas/observation.json, schemas/score.json and evaluation/splits.json. Steps: define as_of availability, mask-year semantics, spatial buffers and sealed seasons. Acceptance: future annual masks cannot enter operational replay and spatial groups remain disjoint. Test: test future timestamps, overlapping tiles and hindsight-view labeling. Dependencies: CS-001, CS-002. Record commands, pinned inputs, observed results and remaining limitations in the output evidence. Keep all data provenance attached and do not introduce manual annotation. Stop at the stated deliverable; any scope or interface change requires the protocol's design review.

Acceptance: the planned pipeline runs without drones, private accounts or GPU hardware. Test: specify CRS alignment, band scaling and local fixture import smoke checks. Dependencies: CS-003. Record commands, pinned inputs, observed results and remaining limitations in the output evidence. Keep all data provenance attached and do not introduce manual annotation. Stop at the stated deliverable; any scope or interface change requires the protocol's design review.

issues.title: Build resumable public-data ingestion
issues.body: Output: src/ingest/ and data/manifests/. Before implementation, split this epic into four 10h children, redistributing its 40h estimate: STAC queries; provenance caching; NASS adapter; resumable download control. Acceptance: available_at and acquired_at remain distinct and retrieval stays inside declared caps. Test: test source outages, pagination, corrupt assets and denied redistribution flags. Dependencies: CS-002, CS-003, CS-004. Complete children in the listed order; each must include its relevant test and evidence in the output directory. Record versions, commands, inputs and limitations. Do not count child estimates again or spend reserve without a milestone decision.
